description_en: Disassociates an Express Connect Router (ECR) from a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a transit router
description_zh: 解除专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）与专有网络（VPC）或者转发路由器的关联关系
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter delete-express-connect-router-association --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --association-id ecr-assoc-9p2qxx5phpca2m0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteExpressConnectRouterAssociation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the association between the ECR and the VPC or transit router
parameters.name: association_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disassociate the ECR from the transit router or VPC. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关是否是删除与TR或VPC的关联关系。取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: delete_attachment

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run to check the request without modifying the service resource.
false (default): Sends a regular request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique parameter value from your client. The client token supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the request ID as the client token. Each request ID is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en: The status code of the call. A value of 200 indicates that the call is successful. Other values indicate that the call failed. For more information, see the error codes section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the `ErrMessage` parameter.

If `ErrMessage` returns `The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid` and `DynamicMessage` returns `DtsJobId`, the specified `DtsJobId` parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: The call was successful.
False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
